verdict.rationale: Agents built with the SDK are inherently driven by natural-language instructions and conversational input (agents are 'LLMs configured with instructions', Runner.run() accepts NL input, and Sessions maintain multi-turn conversation history), so the resulting agent's runtime behavior is NL-native. However, the SDK itself is a code-first developer framework — configuring, running, and orchestrating agents requires Python/JS code (Runner class, FunctionTool wrappers, handoffs config) rather than the user issuing natural-language commands to the SDK/tooling directly.
